content.text: 有官方 vsix 安装校验要求，先读对应 lesson 再装。

input.path: /Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/lessons/2026-08-04-extension-security-官方-vsix-安装前必须-sha256-校验通过-禁止跳.md

input.command: ls -la "/Users/mac/Downloads/dc-platform-0.0.133.vsix" && (command -v cursor; command -v code; ls ~/Library/Application\ Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls ~/.cursor/extensions/ 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'dc-platform|dmp' || ls ~/.vscode/extensions/ 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'dc-platform|dmp' || true)
input.description: Verify vsix exists and find install CLI

content.text: 继续装 `dc-platform-0.0.133.vsix`：先确认文件和当前插件版本，再安装。

input.command: ls -la "/Users/mac/Downloads/dc-platform-0.0.133.vsix" && which cursor code 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cursor/extensions/ 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'dc-platform|dmp|company' || true; ls ~/.vscode/extensions/ 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'dc-platform|dmp|company' || true
input.description: Check vsix and current extension install

input.path: /Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/lessons/2026-08-04-extension-security-官方-vsix-安装前必须-sha256-校验通过-禁止跳.md

input.command: shasum -a 256 "/Users/mac/Downloads/dc-platform-0.0.133.vsix"; cursor --list-extensions --show-versions 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'dc-platform' || true; ls -la ~/.cursor/extensions/dc-platform.dc-platform-*/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; for d in ~/.cursor/extensions/dc-platform.dc-platform-*/; do echo -n "$d: "; python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('${d}package.json'))['version'])" 2>/dev/null; done
input.description: Hash vsix and list installed versions

content.text: PATH 里的 `cursor` 是 agent CLI，不是 IDE。接着找真正的 Cursor 安装路径。

input.command: ls "/Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/cursor" 2>/dev/null; ls /Applications/Cursor*.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/ 2>/dev/null; mdfind "kMDItemCFBundleIdentifier == 'com.todesktop.*cursor*'" 2>/dev/null | head -5; type -a cursor; file $(which cursor); ls ~/Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/ 2>/dev/null
input.description: Locate Cursor IDE binary for vsix install
